explanation: In systems like AIX, modules (often compiled from single source files or groups of related files) contain a Table of Contents (TOC) holding pointers to routines and static data.  Intra-module calls are direct and fast because both caller and callee share the same TOC.  However, inter-module calls require a mechanism to switch between TOCs.  Global Linkage (glink) is this mechanism: a short routine that handles the TOC switching for inter-module function calls, optimizing intra-module calls while managing the overhead of inter-module calls efficiently.
keywords: glink, TOC switching, AIX global linkage
